text: Boston parking tickets become overdue 21 days after issuance. If unpaid within 21 days, a late penalty fee is added to the original fine. Violations range from $15 (minor infractions) to $120 (handicap-only spaces). The most expensive violations include parking in handicap-designated spaces ($120), bike or bus lanes ($100), bus stops ($100), near fire hydrants ($100), and within fire lanes ($100). Street cleaning violations are $40 daytime or $90 overnight.

metadata.source_name: Boston Parking Ticket Fines and Codes

text: Boston parking violation: Parking in a Pedestrian Zone. The fine is $100. If unpaid after 21 days, a late penalty of $33 is added. Pedestrian zones are designated areas where vehicle parking is prohibited to protect pedestrian safety and access.

metadata.source_name: Boston Parking Ticket Fines and Codes

text: Boston parking Zone A vs Zone B fine comparison: Zone A is the downtown core of Boston bounded by the Charles River, Boston University Bridge, Commonwealth Avenue, St. Mary's Street, and Huntington Avenue. Zone B covers the rest of the city outside Zone A. Zone A fines are generally higher than Zone B fines. No Parking Zone A: $90 fine, $18 late penalty. No Parking Zone B: $55 fine, $8 late penalty. Double Parking Zone A: $55 fine, $15 late penalty. Double Parking Zone B: $35 fine, $10 late penalty. Resident Permit Only: $60 fine, $13 late penalty.
